title: CmdPal: Old providers can replace or remove current commands (EXT26.L1-L3)

judgment.rationale: The issue distinguishes three failures and reports isolated stale-load and queued-removal reproductions. The current manager awaits an old sender's load and applies results by ProviderId; callback retention is source-based, not measured.
evidence: Stale refresh overwrite and queued same-ID removal are reported reproduced; callback retention is source-inspected only.
Current UpdateCommandsForProvider awaits sender.LoadTopLevelCommands and replaces by ProviderId.
The related issues 51409/51410 address other provider-result and duplicate cleanup paths; those reports are not interchangeable with L1-L3 lifetime races.
judgment.recommended_action: Use the targeted maintainer reproduction to validate the proposed mechanism before design approval; no upstream action has been taken.

fix_assessment.rationale: No matching fix was identified by focused issue-number search; keep the mechanism as a hypothesis pending reproduction.

confidence.rationale: Two stale-lifetime races are reproduced and ID-based publication is visible; callback retirement and synchronization need focused coverage.

verification: Replace A with B sharing ProviderId, then raise A's ItemsChanged and verify it is ignored.
Pause A's load, publish B, release A and verify B's commands/bands remain.
Queue A removal, register B before execution, release work and verify B remains.
plan: Give each registration an explicit lifetime identity and retire old wrappers/handlers.
Check current wrapper before refresh and again at publication, synchronized with replacement.
Carry wrapper identity through queued removal and clean rejected results without touching replacement objects.
Test L1-L3 separately, including failed unsubscribe.
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Callbacks and queued load/removal work use ProviderId rather than exact wrapper lifetime; an old provider can continue, overwrite a replacement or remove the current same-ID provider.
proposed_fixes.title: Investigate the reported PowerToys behavior

issue_context.summary: Three provider-lifetime races can retain stale callbacks, let an old load overwrite a replacement, or let queued removal delete a same-ID replacement.
